en: Hm? Where are Miu and Kokichi?

I understand why Kokichi's gone,
but where's Miu?

She's probably still messing with that 
computer on the 4th floor.

Or she might be in her lab, working on
another invention.

I saw many half-built machines in her lab
when she performed maintenance on me.

Well, messing with machines and computers
is about all she's good for.
<CLT=cltMIND>What could she be up to...?
Gonta? What's wrong?

Gonta still thinking...since yesterday...
How can Gonta be useful?

But...Gonta no can think of anything!
So...frustrating!

Okay, but you don't need to make 
such a scary face...

Besides...it's not just you. That's something
we all gotta think about.

We all should be thinking about what we
can do to survive...

Use your self-destruct system to save us.
That's how robots make themselves useful.

Even though that is true, at least hesitate
before you blurt out something like that!
<CLT=cltMIND>But you admit it's true, huh...?

I'll...keep thinking about it too. If I come
up with a good idea, I'll tell you guys.

Now that that's settled, let's eat!
If you don't eat well, you can't think well!

<CLT=cltMIND>We finished eating breakfast, and then
returned to our rooms.
<CLT=cltMIND>We needed to get our thoughts together.

<CLT=cltMIND>We were completely unaware...
that an <CLT=cltSTRONG>unspeakable malice<CLT=cltMIND> was brewing.
